questions.question: A standard freight courier leaves a distribution center traveling at 62 mph. Exactly 2 hours later, an express intercept vehicle departs along the identical highway traveling at 86 mph. In how many hours will the express vehicle overtake the freight courier?
questions.explanation:
**Correct Answer: B** (5.2 hours)

**Step-by-step Solution:**
1. Head start distance = 62 mph \times 2 hrs = 124 miles.
2. Relative closing speed = 86 - 62 = 24 mph.
3. Time to overtake = 124 / 24 = **5.2 hours**.
